project.name: Destiny OS :: Calendar
project.description: Vietnamese lunisolar calendar and Can Chi (sexagenary cycle) arithmetic (ADR D3, research items R9/R10/R14a/R15/R16). Foundation infrastructure, not a MetaphysicalEngine: nothing in the codebase yet consumes calendar output as a scenario-participating engine (Bat Tu and Tu Vi, the future consumers, are independently research-blocked on their own algorithms), so this module depends only on destiny-core, the same way destiny-core itself has no framework dependency.
